senses.gloss: ययाति ययाति, m. The name of a king, Śāk. d. 82.
ययि ययि (vb. या, red.), A cloud Chr. 293, 2 = Rigv. i. 87, 2.
ययी ययी (cf. ययि), m. A horse.
ययिन् (vb. या, red., + इन्), ययिन्, m. Śiva.

ऽयायिन् -यायिन्, i. e. या + इन्, adj.
 1. Going in; e. g. नौ-, adj. sbst. Who or what goes in a boat, Man. 8, 409.
 2. Leading to, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 10 (चित्रकूत-, to the mount of Citrakūta).
 3. सतत-, adj. Taking place continually, Man. 1, 50. समुद्र-, adj. m. A navigator of the ocean, 3, 158.

ययु ययु (vb. या, red., + उ), m.
 1. A horse.
 2. A horse fit for sacrifice.
यायजूक यायज् + ऊक (frequent. of यज्), m. A performer of frequent sacrifices.
